items.question: What does the phone message carry from the wait?
options: The first line of the first question, plus kind, project and spec (supersedes the advisor spec's no-question-text rule)
Kind, project and spec only, as the advisor spec decided

items.question: Which config file drives the phone push?
options: notify.json replaces push.json; push.json is no longer read
Read notify.json first, fall back to push.json

items.question: What happens when a drive crashes inside the controller?
options: An error wait with retry/abandon, run goes waiting; Re-drive answers retry; a restart expires it and re-drives
An acknowledge-only wait with Re-drive as the only resume
No wait; the stalled flag only

items.question: Does the one-hour reminder survive a controller restart?
options: Yes: scheduled from the wait's created time, reminded ids recorded

items.question: What is the money, personal-data-and-erasure, and legal/compliance posture (refunds and forfeiture, credits, legal framing)?
options: n/a — the spec touches no money, personal data, or legal surface
